policy.generation: English cover-letter candidate-fit text must use short atomic first-person restatements of verified candidate facts. Do not append purpose, benefit, causal, implementation, alignment, decision, consistency, user-needs or other inferred clauses unless the cited candidate evidence explicitly contains that proposition.
policy.motivation: Motivation may express present interest in the role/vacancy, but must not invent prior familiarity such as having long admired or followed the employer/team unless source evidence supports it.
